Tier2 link conversion with accessible names enabled

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, InlineDataMedia, TierStrategy, convertWithAccessibleNames } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { inlineDataMedia: InlineDataMedia.AltTextOnly, tierStrategy: TierStrategy.Tier2 };
  const result = convertWithAccessibleNames("<p>see <a href=\"https://example.com/x\">GitHub<svg aria-label=\"(opens in new tab)\"><use href=\"#ext\"></use></svg></a> now</p>", true, options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
